    container_name: resume_postgres
    restart: always
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USERNAME:-postgres}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD:-postgres123}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_DATABASE:-back_resume}

    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    networks:
      - resume_network
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${DB_USERNAME:-postgres}"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    command: >
      postgres 
      -c max_connections=100 
      -c shared_buffers=256MB 
      -c effective_cache_size=768MB 
      -c maintenance_work_mem=64MB 
      -c checkpoint_completion_target=0.9

      -c random_page_cost=1.1

      - resume_network

    async seedAdmin() {
        const adminEmail = process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL;
        const adminPassword = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD;
        if (!adminEmail || !adminPassword) {
            this.logger.warn('ADMIN_EMAIL or ADMIN_PASSWORD not set in .env. Skipping admin seed.');
            return;
        }
        const existingAdmin = await this.userRepo.findOne({
            where: { email: adminEmail },
        });
        if (!existingAdmin) {
            const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(adminPassword, 10);
            const admin = this.userRepo.create({
                email: adminEmail,
                password: hashedPassword,
                firstname: 'Hossein',
                lastname: 'Rezaei',
                age: 24,
                refreshToken: null,
            });
            await this.userRepo.save(admin);
            this.logger.log('✅ Admin user seeded successfully');
        }
        else {
            this.logger.log('ℹ️ Admin user already exists, skipping seed');
        }
    }
};

        this.validateUniqueLanguages(dto.translations);
        const queryRunner = this.dataSource.createQueryRunner();
        await queryRunner.connect();
        await queryRunner.startTransaction();
        try {
            let about = await queryRunner.manager.findOne(about_entity_1.About, {
                where: { id: 1 },
            });
            if (!about) {
                about = new about_entity_1.About();
                about.id = 1;
            }
            about.email = dto.email;
            about.phone = dto.phone ?? '';
            about.avatar = dto.avatar ?? '';
            about.resumeUrl = dto.resumeUrl ?? '';
            about.resumeFileName = dto.resumeFileName ?? '';
            about.github = dto.socialLinks?.github ?? '';
            about.linkedin = dto.socialLinks?.linkedin ?? '';
            about.twitter = dto.socialLinks?.twitter ?? '';
            about.youtube = dto.socialLinks?.youtube ?? '';
            about.website = dto.socialLinks?.website ?? '';
            about.available = dto.available;
            about.openToWork = dto.openToWork;
            await queryRunner.manager.save(about);
            await queryRunner.manager.delete(about_translation_entity_1.AboutTranslation, { aboutId: about.id });
            const translations = dto.translations.map((t) => {
                const tr = new about_translation_entity_1.AboutTranslation();
                tr.language = t.language;
                tr.name = t.name;
                tr.title = t.title;
                tr.bio = t.bio;
                tr.location = t.location ?? null;
                tr.aboutSections = (t.aboutSections ??
                    []);
                tr.expertise = (t.expertise ?? []);
                tr.about = about;
                tr.aboutId = about.id;
                return tr;
            });
            await queryRunner.manager.save(translations);
            await queryRunner.commitTransaction();
            this.logger.log('About upserted successfully');
            return await this.getAll();
        }
        catch (error) {
            await queryRunner.rollbackTransaction();
            const err = error;
            this.logger.error(`Error in About upsert: ${err.message}`, err.stack);
            throw new common_1.InternalServerErrorException(process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development'
                ? err.message
                : 'Error saving About');
        }
        finally {
            await queryRunner.release();
        }
    }
    async remove() {
        const about = await this.aboutRepo.findOne({ where: { id: 1 } });
        if (!about) {
            throw new common_1.NotFoundException('About not found');
        }
        await this.aboutRepo.remove(about);
        return { message: 'About deleted successfully' };
    }
    formatSingle(about, t) {
        return {
            email: about.email,
            phone: about.phone ?? '',
            location: t.location,
            avatar: about.avatar ?? '',
            bio: t.bio,
            name: t.name,
            title: t.title,
            socialLinks: {
                github: about.github ?? '',
                linkedin: about.linkedin ?? '',
                twitter: about.twitter ?? '',
                youtube: about.youtube ?? '',
                website: about.website ?? '',
            },
            available: about.available,
            openToWork: about.openToWork,
            resumeUrl: about.resumeUrl ?? '',
            resumeFileName: about.resumeFileName ?? '',
            aboutSections: t.aboutSections ?? [],
            expertise: t.expertise ?? [],
            language: t.language,
            createdAt: about.createdAt,
            updatedAt: about.updatedAt,
        };
    }
    formatFull(about) {
        const translations = about.translations ?? [];
        return {
            email: about.email,
            phone: about.phone ?? '',
            avatar: about.avatar ?? '',
            resumeUrl: about.resumeUrl ?? '',
            resumeFileName: about.resumeFileName ?? '',
            socialLinks: {
                github: about.github ?? '',
                linkedin: about.linkedin ?? '',
                twitter: about.twitter ?? '',
                youtube: about.youtube ?? '',
                website: about.website ?? '',
            },
            available: about.available,
            openToWork: about.openToWork,
            translations: translations.map((t) => ({
                id: t.id,
                language: t.language,
                name: t.name,
                title: t.title,
                bio: t.bio,
                location: t.location,
                aboutSections: t.aboutSections ?? [],
                expertise: t.expertise ?? [],
            })),
            createdAt: about.createdAt,
            updatedAt: about.updatedAt,
        };
    }
    validateUniqueLanguages(translations) {
        const seen = new Set();
        for (const t of translations) {
            if (!constants_1.SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.includes(t.language)) {
                throw new common_1.BadRequestException(`Language "${t.language}" is not supported`);
            }
            if (seen.has(t.language)) {
                throw new common_1.BadRequestException(`Duplicate language "${t.language}" in translations`);
            }
            seen.add(t.language);
        }
    }
};

    generateTokens(userId, email) {
        const payload = { sub: userId, email };
        const accessToken = this.jwtService.sign(payload, { expiresIn: '1d' });
        const refreshToken = this.jwtService.sign(payload, { expiresIn: '7d' });
        return { accessToken, refreshToken };
    }

            throw new common_1.HttpException('User already exists', 400);
        }
        return { message: 'User registered successfully' };
    }
    async login(loginDto, res) {

        if (email !== process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL) {
            throw new common_1.UnauthorizedException('Access denied: only admin can login');
        }
        const user = await this.usersService.findUserByEmail(email);
        if (!user) {
            throw new common_1.HttpException('User not found', 404);
        }
        const isPasswordValid = await bcrypt.compare(password, user.password);
        if (!isPasswordValid) {
            throw new common_1.HttpException('Wrong password', 400);
        }

        const hashedRefreshToken = await bcrypt.hash(refreshToken, 10);
        await this.usersService.updateRefreshToken(user.id, hashedRefreshToken);
        res.cookie('refresh_token', refreshToken, {
            httpOnly: true,
            secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
            sameSite: 'strict',
            maxAge: 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
        });
        return { access_token: accessToken };
    }

        try {
            const payload = this.jwtService.verify(refreshToken);
            const user = await this.usersService.findOneById(payload.sub);
            if (!user || !user.refreshToken) {
                throw new common_1.UnauthorizedException('Invalid refresh token');
            }
            const isMatch = await bcrypt.compare(refreshToken, user.refreshToken);
            if (!isMatch) {
                throw new common_1.UnauthorizedException('Refresh token mismatch');
            }
            const { accessToken, refreshToken: newRefreshToken } = this.generateTokens(user.id, user.email);
            const newHashedRefresh = await bcrypt.hash(newRefreshToken, 10);
            await this.usersService.updateRefreshToken(user.id, newHashedRefresh);
            res.cookie('refresh_token', newRefreshToken, {
                httpOnly: true,
                secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
                sameSite: 'strict',
                maxAge: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
            });
            return { access_token: accessToken };
        }
        catch (error) {
            throw new common_1.UnauthorizedException('Invalid or expired refresh token');
        }
    }
    async logout(userId, res) {
        await this.usersService.updateRefreshToken(userId, null);
        res.clearCookie('refresh_token');
        return { message: 'Logged out successfully' };
    }
};

        let contact = await this.contactRepo.findOne({ where: { id: FIXED_ID } });
        if (!contact) {
            contact = this.contactRepo.create({
                id: FIXED_ID,
                email: 'admin@example.com',
            });
            await this.contactRepo.save(contact);
            this.logger.log('Default contact record created with id=1');
        }

    }

    }
    async updateContactInfo(updateDto) {
        const contact = await this.getContactEntity();
        Object.assign(contact, updateDto);
        await this.contactRepo.save(contact);
        return contact;
    }
    async submitMessage(dto, lang = 'en') {
        const contact = await this.getContactEntity();
        const newMessage = this.messageRepo.create({
            senderName: dto.senderName,
            senderEmail: dto.senderEmail,
            subject: dto.subject,
            body: dto.message,
            contact,
            contactId: contact.id,
        });
        await this.messageRepo.save(newMessage);
        const adminEmail = process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL;
        if (adminEmail) {
            try {
                const htmlContent = `
      <div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;">
        <h2>📬 پیام جدید از سایت</h2>
        <p><strong>نام:</strong> ${dto.senderName}</p>
        <p><strong>ایمیل:</strong> ${dto.senderEmail}</p>
        <p><strong>موضوع:</strong> ${dto.subject}</p>
        <p><strong>متن پیام:</strong></p>
        <div style="background: #f9f9f9; padding: 15px; border-radius: 5px;">
          ${dto.message.replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
                await this.mailerService.sendMail({
                    to: adminEmail,
                    subject: `📬 پیام جدید از ${dto.senderName}: ${dto.subject}`,
                    html: htmlContent,
                });
                this.logger.log(`Email sent to admin for message ID ${newMessage.id}`);
            }
            catch (err) {
                this.logger.error(`Failed to send email: ${err.message}`, err.stack);
            }
        }
        const successMessage = this.i18n.translate('contact.message_sent', { lang });
        return { message: successMessage };
    }
    async findAllMessages() {
        return this.messageRepo.find({
            order: { receivedAt: 'DESC' },
        });
    }
    async findOneMessage(id) {
        const msg = await this.messageRepo.findOne({ where: { id } });
        if (!msg)

    }
    async removeMessage(id) {
        const msg = await this.findOneMessage(id);

import { APP_GUARD } from '@nestjs/core';

import { AboutSeeder } from './database/seeder/about.seeder';
import { About } from './modules/about/entities/about.entity';
import { AboutTranslation } from './modules/about/entities/about-translation.entity';

import { AppController } from './app.controller';
import { AppService } from './app.service';
import { UsersModule } from './modules/admin/users/users.module';
import { AuthModule } from './modules/admin/auth/auth.module';
import { AboutModule } from './modules/about/about.module';
import { BlogModule } from './modules/blog/blog.module';
import { ContactModule } from './modules/contact/contact.module';
import { SeederService } from './database/seeder/seeder.service';
import UserEntity from './modules/admin/users/entities/user.entity';
import { LoggerMiddleware } from './common/middleware/logger.middleware';
import { HeroModule } from './modules/site/hero/hero.module';

@Module({
  imports: [
    // 1. تنظیمات ماژول محیطی (بارگذاری فایل .env)
    ConfigModule.forRoot({
      envFilePath: '.env',
      isGlobal: true,
      cache: true,
    }),

    // 2. Rate Limiting
    ThrottlerModule.forRoot({
      throttlers: [
        {
          ttl: 60000, // 1 دقیقه
          limit: 100, // حداکثر 100 درخواست در دقیقه
        },
      ],
    }),

    // 3. Cache Module با Redis
    CacheModule.registerAsync({
      isGlobal: true,
      useFactory: async () => ({
        store: await redisStore({
          socket: {
            host: process.env.REDIS_HOST || 'localhost',
            port: parseInt(process.env.REDIS_PORT || '6379'),
          },
          ttl: parseInt(process.env.CACHE_TTL || '300'), // 5 دقیقه
        }),
      }),
    }),

    // 4. تنظیمات ایمیل (Mailer)
    MailerModule.forRootAsync({
      imports: [ConfigModule],
      useFactory: (configService: ConfigService) => ({
        transport: {
          host: configService.get<string>('SMTP_HOST', 'smtp.gmail.com'),
          port: configService.get<number>('SMTP_PORT', 587),
          secure: configService.get<boolean>('SMTP_SECURE', false),
          auth: {
            user: configService.get<string>('SMTP_USER'),
            pass: configService.get<string>('SMTP_PASS'),
          },
        },
        defaults: {
          from: `"${configService.get<string>('FROM_NAME', 'My Site')}" <${configService.get<string>('FROM_EMAIL', 'noreply@mysite.com')}>`,
        },
        template: {
          dir: path.join(__dirname, 'templates'),
          options: { strict: true },
        },
      }),
      inject: [ConfigService],
    }),

    // 5. تنظیمات دیتابیس (TypeORM)
    TypeOrmModule.forRootAsync({
      imports: [ConfigModule],
      useFactory: (configService: ConfigService) => ({
        type: 'postgres',
        host: configService.get<string>('DB_HOST', 'localhost'),
        port: configService.get<number>('DB_PORT', 5432),
        username: configService.get<string>('DB_USERNAME'),
        password: configService.get<string>('DB_PASSWORD'),
        database: configService.get<string>('DB_DATABASE'),
        entities: [__dirname + '/**/*.entity{.ts,.js}'],
        synchronize: process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production', // فقط در محیط development
        maxQueryExecutionTime: 1000,
        logging:
          process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' ? ['error', 'warn'] : false,
        extra: {
          max: 20,
          idleTimeoutMillis: 30000,
          connectionTimeoutMillis: 5000,
        },
        // اضافه کردن SSL برای production
        ...(process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && {
          ssl: {
            rejectUnauthorized: false,
          },
        }),
      }),
      inject: [ConfigService],
    }),

    // 6. تنظیمات بین‌المللی (i18n)
    I18nModule.forRoot({
      fallbackLanguage: 'en',
      loaderOptions: {
        path: path.join(__dirname, '/i18n/'),
        watch: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development',
      },
      resolvers: [
        new HeaderResolver(['x-custom-lang']),
        new QueryResolver(['lang']),
        new AcceptLanguageResolver(),
      ],
    }),

    // 7. رجیستر کردن موجودیت User برای استفاده در سرویس Seeder
    TypeOrmModule.forFeature([UserEntity, About, AboutTranslation]),

    // 8. ماژول‌های کاربردی برنامه
    UsersModule,
    AuthModule,
    AboutModule,
    BlogModule,
    ContactModule,
    HeroModule,
  ],
  controllers: [AppController],
  providers: [
    AppService,
    SeederService,
    AboutSeeder,
    {
      provide: APP_GUARD,
      useClass: ThrottlerGuard,
    },
  ],
})
export class AppModule implements NestModule {
  configure(consumer: MiddlewareConsumer) {
    consumer.apply(LoggerMiddleware).forRoutes('*');
  }
}

import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { AppModule } from './app.module';
import session from 'express-session';
import passport from 'passport';
import { ValidationPipe, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { DocumentBuilder, SwaggerModule } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
import * as dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { json, urlencoded } from 'express';
import helmet from 'helmet';
import compression from 'compression';
import { winstonLogger } from './logger/winston-logger';
import { WinstonModule } from 'nest-winston';

async function bootstrap() {
  const logger = new Logger('Bootstrap');

  // ایجاد app با Winston Logger
  const app = await NestFactory.create(AppModule, {
    logger: WinstonModule.createLogger({
      // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-assignment
      instance: winstonLogger,
    }),
  });

  // امنیت - Helmet
  app.use(
    helmet({
      contentSecurityPolicy: {
        directives: {
          defaultSrc: ["'self'"],
          styleSrc: ["'self'", "'unsafe-inline'"],
          imgSrc: ["'self'", 'data:', 'https:'],
          scriptSrc: ["'self'"],
          fontSrc: ["'self'", 'https:', 'data:'],
        },
      },
      crossOriginEmbedderPolicy: false,
    }),
  );

  // فشرده‌سازی
  app.use(
    compression({
      threshold: 1024, // فایل‌های بزرگتر از 1KB فشرده شوند
      level: 6,
      filter: (req, res) => {
        if (req.headers['x-no-compression']) {
          return false;
        }
        return compression.filter(req, res);
      },
    }),
  );

  // محدودیت حجم درخواست - افزایش برای آپلود فایل
  app.use(json({ limit: '50mb' }));
  app.use(urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: '50mb' }));

  // CORS - محدودتر
  app.enableCors({
    origin: process.env.FRONTEND_URL
      ? process.env.FRONTEND_URL.split(',')
      : ['http://localhost:3000', 'http://localhost:3001'],
    credentials: true,
    methods: ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE', 'OPTIONS'],
    allowedHeaders: [
      'Content-Type',
      'Authorization',
      'X-Requested-With',
      'Accept',
      'Origin',
    ],
    exposedHeaders: ['Content-Range', 'X-Content-Range'],
    maxAge: 86400, // 24 ساعت
  });

  // Validation Pipe با تنظیمات امنیتی
  app.useGlobalPipes(
    new ValidationPipe({
      whitelist: true,
      forbidNonWhitelisted: true,
      transform: true,
      transformOptions: {
        enableImplicitConversion: false,
      },
      validationError: {
        target: false,
        value: false,
      },
    }),
  );

  // Middleware‌ها
  app.use(cookieParser());
  app.use(
    session({
      secret: process.env.SESSION_SECRET || 'secret',
      resave: false,
      saveUninitialized: false,
      cookie: {
        secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
        httpOnly: true,
        maxAge: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, // 7 روز
        sameSite: 'strict',
      },
    }),
  );
  app.use(passport.initialize());
  app.use(passport.session());
  dotenv.config();

  // Swagger - فقط در محیط development
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') {
    const config = new DocumentBuilder()
      .setTitle('My Products Site API')
      .setDescription('This is Products API documentation')
      .setVersion('1.0')
      .addBearerAuth(
        {
          type: 'http',
          scheme: 'bearer',
          bearerFormat: 'JWT',
          name: 'JWT',
          description: 'Enter JWT token',
          in: 'header',
        },
        'access-token',
      )
      .addTag('auth', 'Authentication endpoints')
      .addTag('users', 'User management')
      .addTag('blog', 'Blog endpoints')
      .addTag('portfolio', 'Portfolio management')
      .addTag('contact', 'Contact management')
      .addTag('about', 'About section')
      .build();

    const document = SwaggerModule.createDocument(app, config);
    SwaggerModule.setup('docs', app, document, {
      swaggerOptions: {
        persistAuthorization: true,
        docExpansion: 'none',
        filter: true,
        showRequestDuration: true,
      },
      customSiteTitle: 'My Products API Docs',
    });
    logger.log('Swagger documentation available at /docs');
  }

  const port = process.env.PORT ?? 3001;
  await app.listen(port);
  logger.log(`Application is running on: http://localhost:${port}`);
  logger.log(`Environment: ${process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development'}`);
}

bootstrap().catch((error) => {
  console.error('Failed to start application:', error);
  process.exit(1);
});

📂 File Path: \src\common\interceptors\cache.interceptor.ts

import {
  Injectable,
  ExecutionContext,
  CallHandler,
  Logger,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { CacheInterceptor } from '@nestjs/cache-manager';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { tap } from 'rxjs/operators';

@Injectable()
export class CustomCacheInterceptor extends CacheInterceptor {
  private readonly logger = new Logger('Cache');

  protected async trackBy(
    context: ExecutionContext,
  ): Promise<string | undefined> {
    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-assignment
    const { method, url, query } = request;

    if (method !== 'GET') return undefined;
    if (url.includes('/admin/')) return undefined;

    const key = `${method}-${url}-${JSON.stringify(query)}`;
    this.logger.debug(`Cache key: ${key}`);
    return key;
  }

  // ✅ حالا async هست و Promise<Observable> برمی‌گردونه
  async intercept(
    context: ExecutionContext,
    next: CallHandler,
  ): Promise<Observable<any>> {
    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-assignment, @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-member-access
    const isPublic = !request.headers?.authorization;

    if (!isPublic) {
      return next.handle();
    }

    const result$ = await super.intercept(context, next);

    return result$.pipe(
      tap(() => {
        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-assignment, @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-member-access
        const url = request.url;
        this.logger.debug(`Cached response for: ${String(url)}`);
      }),
    );
  }
}

📂 File Path: \src\common\middleware\logger.middleware.ts

import { Injectable, NestMiddleware, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';

@Injectable()
export class LoggerMiddleware implements NestMiddleware {
  private logger = new Logger('HTTP');

  use(req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) {
    const { method, originalUrl, ip } = req;
    const userAgent = req.get('user-agent') || '';
    const startTime = Date.now();

    // لاگ درخواست
    this.logger.log(`➡️  ${method} ${originalUrl} - ${userAgent} ${ip}`);

    res.on('finish', () => {
      const { statusCode } = res;
      const contentLength = res.get('content-length') || 0;
      const responseTime = Date.now() - startTime;

      let logLevel = 'log';
      if (statusCode >= 500) logLevel = 'error';
      else if (statusCode >= 400) logLevel = 'warn';

      this.logger[logLevel](
        `⬅️  ${method} ${originalUrl} ${statusCode} ${contentLength}B - ${responseTime}ms`,
      );
    });

    next();
  }
}

// src/seeder/seeder.service.ts
import { Injectable, OnApplicationBootstrap, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import UserEntity from '../../modules/admin/users/entities/user.entity';

@Injectable()
export class SeederService implements OnApplicationBootstrap {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(SeederService.name);

  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(UserEntity)
    private userRepo: Repository<UserEntity>,
  ) {}

  async onApplicationBootstrap() {
    await this.seedAdmin();
  }

  private async seedAdmin() {
    const adminEmail = process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL;
    const adminPassword = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD;

    if (!adminEmail || !adminPassword) {
      this.logger.warn(
        'ADMIN_EMAIL or ADMIN_PASSWORD not set in .env. Skipping admin seed.',
      );
      return;
    }

    const existingAdmin = await this.userRepo.findOne({
      where: { email: adminEmail },
    });

    if (!existingAdmin) {
      const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(adminPassword, 10);
      const admin = this.userRepo.create({
        email: adminEmail,
        password: hashedPassword,
        firstname: 'Hossein',
        lastname: 'Rezaei',
        age: 24,
        refreshToken: null,
      } as UserEntity); // استفاده از as UserEntity برای رفع خطای TypeScript

      await this.userRepo.save(admin);
      this.logger.log('✅ Admin user seeded successfully');
    } else {
      this.logger.log('ℹ️ Admin user already exists, skipping seed');
    }
  }
}

📂 File Path: \src\logger\winston-logger.ts

import * as winston from 'winston';
import 'winston-daily-rotate-file';
import * as path from 'node:path';
import * as fs from 'node:fs';

// اطمینان از وجود پوشه لاگ‌ها
const logDir = path.join(process.cwd(), 'logs');
if (!fs.existsSync(logDir)) {
  fs.mkdirSync(logDir, { recursive: true });
}

const { combine, timestamp, printf, colorize, errors, json } = winston.format;

// فرمت برای کنسول (رنگی و خوانا)
const consoleFormat = printf(({ level, message, timestamp, context, trace }) => {
  const ctx = context ? ` [${String(context)}]` : '';
  const stack = trace ? `\n${String(trace)}` : '';
  return `${String(timestamp)} ${level}${ctx}: ${String(message)}${stack}`;
});

// فرمت برای فایل (JSON)
const fileFormat = combine(timestamp(), errors({ stack: true }), json());

export const winstonLogger = winston.createLogger({
  level: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info',
  format: combine(
    timestamp({ format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss' }),
    errors({ stack: true }),
  ),
  defaultMeta: { service: 'resume-api' },
  transports: [
    // کنسول
    new winston.transports.Console({
      format: combine(
        colorize({ all: true }),
        timestamp({ format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss' }),
        consoleFormat,
      ),
    }),

    // فایل روزانه - خطاها
    new winston.transports.DailyRotateFile({
      dirname: logDir,
      filename: 'error-%DATE%.log',
      datePattern: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
      level: 'error',
      maxFiles: '14d',
      format: fileFormat,
    }),

    // فایل روزانه - همه لاگ‌ها
    new winston.transports.DailyRotateFile({
      dirname: logDir,
      filename: 'combined-%DATE%.log',
      datePattern: 'YYYY-MM-DD',
      maxFiles: '14d',
      format: fileFormat,
    }),
  ],
  exitOnError: false,
});

  ApiOkResponse,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiQuery,
  ApiTags,
  ApiUnauthorizedResponse,
} from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AboutService } from './about.service';
import { UpsertAboutDto } from './dto/upsert-about.dto';
import { DEFAULT_LANGUAGE } from '../../common/constants';

@ApiTags('about')
@Controller('about')
export class AboutController {
  constructor(private readonly aboutService: AboutService) {}

  // ── عمومی ──
  @Get()
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'دریافت About به زبان مشخص (عمومی)',
    description: 'اگه زبان درخواستی موجود نبود، به en یا fa برمی‌گرده.',
  })
  @ApiQuery({ name: 'lang', required: false, example: 'fa' })
  @ApiOkResponse({ description: 'اطلاعات About' })
  getByLanguage(@Query('lang') lang?: string) {
    return this.aboutService.getByLanguage(lang || DEFAULT_LANGUAGE);
  }

  // ── ادمین ──
  @Get('admin')
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'دریافت About با همه ترجمه‌ها (ادمین)' })
  @ApiOkResponse({ description: 'About با آرایه کامل ترجمه‌ها' })
  @ApiUnauthorizedResponse({ description: 'نیاز به ورود' })
  getAll() {
    return this.aboutService.getAll();
  }

  @Put()
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'ایجاد یا به‌روزرسانی About (ادمین)',
    description: 'همه ترجمه‌های قبلی حذف و با ترجمه‌های جدید جایگزین می‌شن.',
  })
  @ApiBody({ type: UpsertAboutDto })
  @ApiOkResponse({ description: 'About با موفقیت ذخیره شد' })
  @ApiUnauthorizedResponse({ description: 'نیاز به ورود' })
  upsert(@Body() dto: UpsertAboutDto) {
    return this.aboutService.upsert(dto);
  }

  @Delete()
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'حذف کامل About (ادمین)' })
  @ApiOkResponse({ description: 'About حذف شد' })
  @ApiUnauthorizedResponse({ description: 'نیاز به ورود' })
  remove() {
    return this.aboutService.remove();
  }
}

📂 File Path: \src\modules\about\about.service.ts

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  InternalServerErrorException,
  BadRequestException,
  Logger,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, DataSource } from 'typeorm';
import { About } from './entities/about.entity';
import { AboutTranslation } from './entities/about-translation.entity';
import { UpsertAboutDto } from './dto/upsert-about.dto';
import { AboutTranslationDto } from './dto/about-translation.dto';
import { DEFAULT_LANGUAGE, SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES } from '../../common/constants';

export interface SocialLinks {
  github: string;
  linkedin: string;
  twitter: string;
  youtube: string;
  website: string;
}

export interface AboutSingleResponse {
  email: string;
  phone: string;
  location: string | null;
  avatar: string;
  bio: string;
  name: string;
  title: string;
  socialLinks: SocialLinks;
  available: boolean;
  openToWork: boolean;
  resumeUrl: string;
  resumeFileName: string;
  aboutSections: AboutTranslation['aboutSections'];
  expertise: AboutTranslation['expertise'];
  language: string;
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
}

export interface AboutFullResponse {
  email: string;
  phone: string;
  avatar: string;
  resumeUrl: string;
  resumeFileName: string;
  socialLinks: SocialLinks;
  available: boolean;
  openToWork: boolean;
  translations: {
    id: number;
    language: string;
    name: string;
    title: string;
    bio: string;
    location: string | null;
    aboutSections: AboutTranslation['aboutSections'];
    expertise: AboutTranslation['expertise'];
  }[];
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
}

@Injectable()
export class AboutService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(AboutService.name);

  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(About)
    private readonly aboutRepo: Repository<About>,
    @InjectRepository(AboutTranslation)
    private readonly translationRepo: Repository<AboutTranslation>,
    private readonly dataSource: DataSource,
  ) {}

  async getByLanguage(
    lang: string = DEFAULT_LANGUAGE,
  ): Promise<AboutSingleResponse> {
    const about = await this.aboutRepo.findOne({
      where: { id: 1 },
      relations: ['translations'],
    });

    if (!about) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        'About record not found. Please create it via PUT /about',
      );
    }

    const translations = about.translations ?? [];
    const translation =
      translations.find((t) => t.language === lang) ??
      translations.find((t) => t.language === 'en') ??
      translations.find((t) => t.language === 'fa') ??
      translations[0];

    if (!translation) {
      throw new NotFoundException('No translation available for About');
    }

    return this.formatSingle(about, translation);
  }

  async getAll(): Promise<AboutFullResponse> {
    const about = await this.aboutRepo.findOne({
      where: { id: 1 },
      relations: ['translations'],
    });

    if (!about) {
      throw new NotFoundException(
        'About record not found. Please create it via PUT /about',
      );
    }

    return this.formatFull(about);
  }

  async upsert(dto: UpsertAboutDto): Promise<AboutFullResponse> {
    this.validateUniqueLanguages(dto.translations);

    const queryRunner = this.dataSource.createQueryRunner();
    await queryRunner.connect();
    await queryRunner.startTransaction();

    try {
      let about = await queryRunner.manager.findOne(About, {
        where: { id: 1 },
      });
      if (!about) {
        about = new About();
        about.id = 1;
      }

      about.email = dto.email;
      about.phone = dto.phone ?? '';
      about.avatar = dto.avatar ?? '';
      about.resumeUrl = dto.resumeUrl ?? '';
      about.resumeFileName = dto.resumeFileName ?? '';
      about.github = dto.socialLinks?.github ?? '';
      about.linkedin = dto.socialLinks?.linkedin ?? '';
      about.twitter = dto.socialLinks?.twitter ?? '';
      about.youtube = dto.socialLinks?.youtube ?? '';
      about.website = dto.socialLinks?.website ?? '';
      about.available = dto.available;
      about.openToWork = dto.openToWork;

      await queryRunner.manager.save(about);

      await queryRunner.manager.delete(AboutTranslation, { aboutId: about.id });

      const translations = dto.translations.map((t: AboutTranslationDto) => {
        const tr = new AboutTranslation();
        tr.language = t.language;
        tr.name = t.name;
        tr.title = t.title;
        tr.bio = t.bio;
        tr.location = t.location ?? null;
        tr.aboutSections = (t.aboutSections ??
          []) as AboutTranslation['aboutSections'];
        tr.expertise = (t.expertise ?? []) as AboutTranslation['expertise'];
        tr.about = about!;
        tr.aboutId = about.id;
        return tr;
      });

      await queryRunner.manager.save(translations);

      await queryRunner.commitTransaction();
      this.logger.log('About upserted successfully');

      return await this.getAll();
    } catch (error) {
      await queryRunner.rollbackTransaction();
      const err = error as Error;
      this.logger.error(`Error in About upsert: ${err.message}`, err.stack);
      throw new InternalServerErrorException(
        process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development'
          ? err.message
          : 'Error saving About',
      );
    } finally {
      await queryRunner.release();
    }
  }

  async remove(): Promise<{ message: string }> {
    const about = await this.aboutRepo.findOne({ where: { id: 1 } });
    if (!about) {
      throw new NotFoundException('About not found');
    }
    await this.aboutRepo.remove(about);
    return { message: 'About deleted successfully' };
  }

  private formatSingle(about: About, t: AboutTranslation): AboutSingleResponse {
    return {
      email: about.email,
      phone: about.phone ?? '',
      location: t.location,
      avatar: about.avatar ?? '',
      bio: t.bio,
      name: t.name,
      title: t.title,
      socialLinks: {
        github: about.github ?? '',
        linkedin: about.linkedin ?? '',
        twitter: about.twitter ?? '',
        youtube: about.youtube ?? '',
        website: about.website ?? '',
      },
      available: about.available,
      openToWork: about.openToWork,
      resumeUrl: about.resumeUrl ?? '',
      resumeFileName: about.resumeFileName ?? '',
      aboutSections: t.aboutSections ?? [],
      expertise: t.expertise ?? [],
      language: t.language,
      createdAt: about.createdAt,
      updatedAt: about.updatedAt,
    };
  }

  private formatFull(about: About): AboutFullResponse {
    const translations = about.translations ?? [];
    return {
      email: about.email,
      phone: about.phone ?? '',
      avatar: about.avatar ?? '',
      resumeUrl: about.resumeUrl ?? '',
      resumeFileName: about.resumeFileName ?? '',
      socialLinks: {
        github: about.github ?? '',
        linkedin: about.linkedin ?? '',
        twitter: about.twitter ?? '',
        youtube: about.youtube ?? '',
        website: about.website ?? '',
      },
      available: about.available,
      openToWork: about.openToWork,
      translations: translations.map((t) => ({
        id: t.id,
        language: t.language,
        name: t.name,
        title: t.title,
        bio: t.bio,
        location: t.location,
        aboutSections: t.aboutSections ?? [],
        expertise: t.expertise ?? [],
      })),
      createdAt: about.createdAt,
      updatedAt: about.updatedAt,
    };
  }

  private validateUniqueLanguages(translations: AboutTranslationDto[]): void {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    for (const t of translations) {
      if (!SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES.includes(t.language as never)) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          `Language "${t.language}" is not supported`,
        );
      }
      if (seen.has(t.language)) {
        throw new BadRequestException(
          `Duplicate language "${t.language}" in translations`,
        );
      }
      seen.add(t.language);
    }
  }
}

import { ApiProperty, ApiPropertyOptional } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { Type } from 'class-transformer';
import {

  IsIn,
  IsInt,
  IsOptional,
  IsString,
  Length,
  Min,
  ValidateNested,
} from 'class-validator';

// ============ Sub-DTOs برای jsonb ============

export class AboutSectionDataDto {
  @ApiProperty({ example: 'sec-1' })
  @IsString()

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'Code2', description: 'نام آیکون Lucide' })
  @IsString()
  @Length(1, 50)
  icon: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 0 })
  @IsInt()
  @Min(0)
  order: number;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'پیشینه من' })

  @IsString()
  @Length(1, 50)

  @ApiProperty({ example: 0 })
  @IsInt()
  @Min(0)
  order: number;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'مهندسی' })
  @IsString()
  @Length(1, 100)
  title: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'ساخت نرم‌افزار مدرن.' })
  @IsString()
  @Length(1, 300)
  description: string;
}

export class AboutTranslationDto {
  @ApiProperty({
    example: 'fa',
    enum: SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES,
    description: 'کد زبان',
  })

  language: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'حسین رضایی', maxLength: 100 })
  @IsString()

  name: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'مهندس نرم‌افزار · امنیت', maxLength: 200 })
  @IsString()
  @Length(1, 200)
  title: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'من یک مهندس نرم‌افزار هستم...' })
  @IsString()
  @Length(1, 5000)
  bio: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ example: 'تهران، ایران', maxLength: 200 })
  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @Length(0, 200)
  location?: string;

  // ============ Sections ============

import {
  Entity,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  Column,
  ManyToOne,
  JoinColumn,
  Unique,
} from 'typeorm';
import { ApiProperty, ApiPropertyOptional } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { About } from './about.entity';

/**
 * ساختار یک AboutSection در jsonb.
 */
export interface AboutSectionData {
  id: string;
  icon: string;
  order: number;
  title: string;
  content: string;
}

/**
 * ساختار یک ExpertiseCard در jsonb.
 */
export interface AboutExpertiseData {
  id: string;
  icon: string;
  order: number;
  title: string;
  description: string;
}

@Entity('about_translations')
@Unique(['aboutId', 'language'])
export class AboutTranslation {
  @ApiProperty({ example: 1 })
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id: number;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'fa', description: 'کد زبان (fa, en, fr, ...)' })
  @Column({ length: 5 })
  language: string;

  // ============ متن‌های اصلی ============
  @ApiProperty({ example: 'حسین رضایی' })
  @Column({ length: 100 })
  name: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'مهندس نرم‌افزار · امنیت' })
  @Column({ length: 200 })
  title: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'من یک مهندس نرم‌افزار هستم...' })
  @Column({ type: 'text' })
  bio: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ example: 'تهران، ایران', nullable: true })
  @Column({ type: 'varchar', nullable: true })
  location: string | null;

  // ============ Sections به صورت jsonb ============
  @ApiProperty({
    type: 'array',
    example: [
      {
        id: 'sec-1',
        icon: 'Code2',
        order: 0,
        title: 'پیشینه من',
        content: 'من یک مهندس نرم‌افزار...',
      },
    ],
  })
  @Column({ type: 'jsonb', default: [] })
  aboutSections: AboutSectionData[];

  // ============ Expertise به صورت jsonb ============
  @ApiProperty({
    type: 'array',
    example: [
      {
        id: 'exp-1',
        icon: 'Code2',
        order: 0,
        title: 'مهندسی',
        description: 'ساخت نرم‌افزار مدرن.',
      },
    ],
  })
  @Column({ type: 'jsonb', default: [] })
  expertise: AboutExpertiseData[];

  // ============ Relation ============
  @ManyToOne(() => About, (about) => about.translations, {
    onDelete: 'CASCADE',
  })
  @JoinColumn({ name: 'about_id' })
  about: About;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 1 })
  @Column({ name: 'about_id' })
  aboutId: number;
}

import {
  Entity,
  PrimaryColumn,
  Column,
  OneToMany,
  CreateDateColumn,
  UpdateDateColumn,
} from 'typeorm';
import { ApiProperty, ApiPropertyOptional } from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { AboutTranslation } from './about-translation.entity';

@Entity('about')
export class About {
  @ApiProperty({ example: 1, description: 'شناسه ثابت (همیشه 1)' })
  @PrimaryColumn({ type: 'int', default: 1 })
  id: number;

  // ============ اطلاعات تک‌زبانه (مشترک بین همه زبان‌ها) ============
  @ApiProperty({ example: 'john.doe@example.com' })
  @Column({ unique: true })
  email: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ example: '+1 (555) 123-4567' })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  phone: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ example: 'https://example.com/avatar.jpg' })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  avatar: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ example: '/resume.pdf' })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  resumeUrl: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ example: 'John_Doe_Resume.pdf' })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  resumeFileName: string;

  // Social (URL یکسانه، ترجمه لازم نداره)
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ example: 'https://github.com/johndoe' })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  github: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ example: 'https://linkedin.com/in/johndoe' })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  linkedin: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ example: 'https://twitter.com/johndoe' })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  twitter: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ example: 'https://youtube.com/@johndoe' })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  youtube: string;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ example: 'https://johndoe.dev' })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  website: string;

  // وضعیت
  @ApiProperty({ example: true })
  @Column({ default: true })
  available: boolean;

  @ApiProperty({ example: true })
  @Column({ default: true })
  openToWork: boolean;

  // ============ Relations ============
  @ApiProperty({ type: () => [AboutTranslation] })
  @OneToMany(() => AboutTranslation, (t) => t.about, { cascade: true })
  translations: AboutTranslation[];

  // ============ Timestamps ============
  @ApiProperty()
  @CreateDateColumn()
  createdAt: Date;

  @ApiProperty()
  @UpdateDateColumn()
  updatedAt: Date;
}

  @Type(() => SocialLinksDto)
  socialLinks: SocialLinksDto;

  @ApiProperty({ example: true })
  @IsBoolean()
  available: boolean;

  @ApiProperty({ example: true })
  @IsBoolean()
  openToWork: boolean;

  @ApiProperty({ type: [AboutTranslationDto] })
  @IsArray()
  @ArrayMinSize(1)
  @ValidateNested({ each: true })
  @Type(() => AboutTranslationDto)
  translations: AboutTranslationDto[];
}

📂 File Path: \src\modules\admin\auth\auth.controller.ts

// src/modules/auth/auth.controller.ts
import {
  Controller,
  Post,
  Body,
  Res,
  Req,
  UseGuards,
  ForbiddenException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { LoginDto } from './dto/login.dto';
import { AuthGuard } from '@nestjs/passport';
import type { Response } from 'express';
import type { RequestWithUser } from '../../../core/guards/userGuard';
import {
  ApiBearerAuth,
  ApiBody,
  ApiCookieAuth,
  ApiOkResponse,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiResponse,
  ApiUnauthorizedResponse,
} from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { LoginResponseDto } from './dto/login-response.dto';
import { MessageResponseDto } from './dto/message-response.dto';

@Controller('auth')
export class AuthController {
  constructor(private readonly authService: AuthService) {}

  // @Post('register')
  // register(@Body() registerDto: RegisterDto) {
  //   return this.authService.register(registerDto);
  // }
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'ثبت‌نام (غیرفعال شده)' })
  @ApiResponse({ status: 403, description: 'Registration is disabled' })
  @Post('register')
  register() {
    throw new ForbiddenException('Registration is disabled');
  }

  @Post('login')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'ورود به سیستم و دریافت توکن' })
  @ApiBody({ type: LoginDto })
  @ApiOkResponse({
    type: LoginResponseDto,
    description:
      'ورود موفق - توکن در body و refresh token در کوکی ذخیره می‌شود',
  })
  @ApiUnauthorizedResponse({ description: 'ایمیل یا رمز عبور اشتباه است' })
  async login(
    @Body() loginDto: LoginDto,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response,
  ) {
    return this.authService.login(loginDto, res);
  }

  @Post('refresh')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'تمدید توکن دسترسی با استفاده از Refresh Token (در کوکی)',
  })
  @ApiCookieAuth('refresh_token')
  @ApiOkResponse({ type: LoginResponseDto, description: 'توکن جدید صادر شد' })
  @ApiUnauthorizedResponse({
    description: 'Refresh token نامعتبر یا منقضی شده است',
  })
  async refresh(
    @Req() req: RequestWithUser,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response,
  ) {
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-assignment
    const refreshToken = req.cookies['refresh_token'];
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-argument
    return this.authService.refreshTokens(refreshToken, res);
  }

  @Post('logout')
  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'خروج از سیستم و حذف Refresh Token (ادمین)' })
  @ApiOkResponse({ type: MessageResponseDto, description: 'خروج موفق' })
  @ApiUnauthorizedResponse({ description: 'توکن دسترسی نامعتبر است' })
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
  async logout(
    @Req() req: RequestWithUser,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) res: Response,
  ) {
    const userId = req.user.id; // دیگر خطا نمی‌دهد
    return this.authService.logout(userId, res);
  }
}

📂 File Path: \src\modules\admin\auth\auth.service.ts
============================================================

import {
  Injectable,
  HttpException,
  UnauthorizedException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtService } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { UsersService } from '../users/users.service';
import { RegisterDto } from './dto/register.dto';
import { LoginDto } from './dto/login.dto';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcrypt';
import { Response } from 'express';

@Injectable()
export class AuthService {
  constructor(
    private readonly usersService: UsersService,
    private readonly jwtService: JwtService,
  ) {}

  private generateTokens(userId: number, email: string) {
    const payload = { sub: userId, email };
    const accessToken = this.jwtService.sign(payload, { expiresIn: '1d' });
    const refreshToken = this.jwtService.sign(payload, { expiresIn: '7d' });
    return { accessToken, refreshToken };
  }

  async register(registerDto: RegisterDto) {
    const existingUser = await this.usersService.findUserByEmail(
      registerDto.email,
    );
    if (existingUser) {
      throw new HttpException('User already exists', 400);
    }
    // const hashedPassword = await bcrypt.hash(registerDto.password, 10);
    // const newUser = await this.usersService.createUser({
    //   ...registerDto,
    //   password: hashedPassword,
    // });
    return { message: 'User registered successfully' };
  }

  async login(loginDto: LoginDto, res: Response) {
    const { email, password } = loginDto;
    if (email !== process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException('Access denied: only admin can login');
    }
    const user = await this.usersService.findUserByEmail(email);
    if (!user) {
      throw new HttpException('User not found', 404);
    }
    const isPasswordValid = await bcrypt.compare(password, user.password);
    if (!isPasswordValid) {
      throw new HttpException('Wrong password', 400);
    }

    const { accessToken, refreshToken } = this.generateTokens(
      user.id,
      user.email,
    );

    // ذخیره refresh token هش شده در دیتابیس (اختیاری)
    const hashedRefreshToken = await bcrypt.hash(refreshToken, 10);
    await this.usersService.updateRefreshToken(user.id, hashedRefreshToken);

    // قراردادن Refresh Token در HttpOnly Cookie
    res.cookie('refresh_token', refreshToken, {
      httpOnly: true,
      secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production', // در توسعه false
      sameSite: 'strict',
      maxAge: 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000, // 1 روز
    });

    return { access_token: accessToken };
  }

  async refreshTokens(refreshToken: string, res: Response) {
    if (!refreshToken) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException('Refresh token not provided');
    }
    try {
      const payload = this.jwtService.verify(refreshToken);
      const user = await this.usersService.findOneById(payload.sub);
      if (!user || !user.refreshToken) {
        throw new UnauthorizedException('Invalid refresh token');
      }
      const isMatch = await bcrypt.compare(refreshToken, user.refreshToken);
      if (!isMatch) {
        throw new UnauthorizedException('Refresh token mismatch');
      }

      const { accessToken, refreshToken: newRefreshToken } =
        this.generateTokens(user.id, user.email);
      const newHashedRefresh = await bcrypt.hash(newRefreshToken, 10);
      await this.usersService.updateRefreshToken(user.id, newHashedRefresh);

      res.cookie('refresh_token', newRefreshToken, {
        httpOnly: true,
        secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
        sameSite: 'strict',
        maxAge: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
      });

      return { access_token: accessToken };
    } catch (error) {
      throw new UnauthorizedException('Invalid or expired refresh token');
    }
  }

  async logout(userId: number, res: Response) {
    await this.usersService.updateRefreshToken(userId, null);
    res.clearCookie('refresh_token');
    return { message: 'Logged out successfully' };
  }
}

📂 File Path: \src\modules\admin\auth\strategies\jwt.strategy.ts

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PassportStrategy } from '@nestjs/passport';
import { Strategy, ExtractJwt } from 'passport-jwt';

@Injectable()
export class JwtStrategy extends PassportStrategy(Strategy) {
  constructor() {
    super({
      jwtFromRequest: ExtractJwt.fromAuthHeaderAsBearerToken(),
      ignoreExpiration: false,
      secretOrKey: 'secret',
    });
  }
  validate(payload: any) {
    return {
      id: payload.sub,
      email: payload.email
    };
  }
}

@Controller('users')
export class UsersController {
  constructor(private readonly usersService: UsersService) {}

  @Get()
  async findAll() {
    return await this.usersService.findAll();
  }

  @Get(':id')
  findOne(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.usersService.findOne(+id);
  }

    return this.usersService.update(+id, updateUserDto);

    return this.usersService.remove(+id);
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import UserEntity from './entities/user.entity';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { RegisterDto } from '../auth/dto/register.dto';
import { UpdateUserDto } from './dto/update-user.dto';

@Injectable()
export class UsersService {
  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(UserEntity)
    private readonly user_repository: Repository<UserEntity>,
  ) {}

  async findOneById(id: number): Promise<UserEntity | null> {
    return await this.user_repository.findOne({ where: { id } });
  }

  async updateRefreshToken(userId: number, refreshToken: string | null) {
    await this.user_repository.update(userId, { refreshToken });
  }

  async findAll() {
    return await this.user_repository.find();
  }

  createUser(data: RegisterDto) {
    const user = this.user_repository.create(data);
    this.user_repository.save(user);
    return user;
  }

  // createUser(data: RegisterDto) {
  //   throw new ForbiddenException('Cannot create new user');
  // }

  findUserByEmail = async (email: string) => {
    return await this.user_repository
      .createQueryBuilder('user')
      .where('user.email = :email', { email })
      .addSelect('user.password')
      .getOne();
  };










  findOne(id: number) {
    return `This action removes a #${id} user`; // پیاده‌سازی موقت (همانند قبل)
  }

  update(id: number, updateUserDto: UpdateUserDto) {
    return `This action updates a #${id} user`;
  }

  remove(id: number) {
    return `This action removes a #${id} user`;
  }
}

import { Column, Entity, PrimaryGeneratedColumn } from 'typeorm';

@Entity('users')
export default class UserEntity {
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn()
  id: number;

  @Column({ unique: true, nullable: false })
  email: string;

  @Column({ length: 25, nullable: true })
  lastname: string;

  @Column({ length: 25, nullable: true })
  firstname: string;

  @Column({ nullable: true })
  age: number;

  @Column({ select: false, nullable: false })
  password: string;

  @Column({ type: 'varchar', nullable: true, select: false })
  refreshToken: string | null;
}

import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Post,
  Body,
  Patch,
  Param,
  Delete,
  UseGuards,
  Query,
  Req,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { AuthGuard } from '@nestjs/passport';
import { BlogService } from './blog.service';
import { CreateBlogDto } from './dto/create-blog.dto';
import { UpdateBlogDto } from './dto/update-blog.dto';
import { DEFAULT_LANGUAGE } from '../../common/constants';
import type { Request } from 'express';
import {
  ApiBearerAuth,
  ApiCreatedResponse,
  ApiOkResponse,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiParam,
  ApiQuery,
  ApiUnauthorizedResponse,
} from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { Blog } from './entities/blog.entity';

@Controller('blog')
export class BlogController {
  constructor(private readonly blogService: BlogService) {}

  @Post()
  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'ایجاد بلاگ جدید (فقط ادمین)' })
  @ApiCreatedResponse({ description: 'بلاگ با موفقیت ایجاد شد', type: Blog })
  @ApiUnauthorizedResponse({ description: 'وارد نشده‌اید یا توکن نامعتبر است' })
  create(@Body() createBlogDto: CreateBlogDto) {
    return this.blogService.create(createBlogDto);
  }

  @Patch(':id')
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'به‌روزرسانی بلاگ (فقط ادمین)' })
  @ApiOkResponse({ description: 'بلاگ به‌روز شد', type: Blog })
  @ApiParam({ name: 'id', type: String, description: 'شناسه UUID بلاگ' })
  update(@Param('id') id: string, @Body() updateBlogDto: UpdateBlogDto) {
    return this.blogService.update(id, updateBlogDto);
  }

  @Delete(':id')
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'حذف بلاگ (فقط ادمین)' })
  @ApiOkResponse({ description: 'بلاگ حذف شد' })
  @ApiParam({ name: 'id', type: String })
  remove(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.blogService.remove(id);
  }

  // عمومی (فقط منتشر شده)
  @Get()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'دریافت لیست بلاگ‌های منتشر شده (عمومی)' })
  @ApiQuery({
    name: 'lang',
    required: false,
    example: 'fa',
    description: 'کد زبان (fa, en, ...)',
  })
  @ApiOkResponse({ type: [Blog], description: 'آرایه‌ای از بلاگ‌ها' })
  async findAll(@Query('lang') lang?: string, @Req() req?: Request) {
    const acceptLanguage = req?.headers['accept-language'];
    const language = lang || acceptLanguage?.split(',')[0] || DEFAULT_LANGUAGE;
    return this.blogService.findAll(language, false);
  }

  @Get(':id')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'دریافت جزئیات یک بلاگ (عمومی - فقط منتشر شده)' })
  @ApiParam({ name: 'id', type: String })
  @ApiQuery({ name: 'lang', required: false, example: 'fa' })
  @ApiOkResponse({ type: Blog })
  async findOne(
    @Param('id') id: string,
    @Query('lang') lang?: string,
    @Req() req?: Request,
  ) {
    const acceptLanguage = req?.headers['accept-language'];
    const language = lang || acceptLanguage?.split(',')[0] || DEFAULT_LANGUAGE;
    return this.blogService.findOne(id, language, false);
  }

  // ادمین (همه وضعیت‌ها)
  @Get('admin/all')
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'دریافت همه بلاگ‌ها (ادمین) - شامل پیش‌نویس و بایگانی',
  })
  @ApiOkResponse({ type: [Blog] })
  async findAllAdmin(@Query('lang') lang?: string) {
    return this.blogService.findAll(lang || DEFAULT_LANGUAGE, true);
  }

  @Get('admin/:id')
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
  @ApiOperation({
    summary: 'دریافت جزئیات بلاگ (ادمین) - حتی اگر پیش‌نویس باشد',
  })
  @ApiParam({ name: 'id', type: String })
  async findOneAdmin(@Param('id') id: string, @Query('lang') lang?: string) {
    return this.blogService.findOne(id, lang || DEFAULT_LANGUAGE, true);
  }
}

📂 File Path: \src\modules\blog\blog.service.ts
============================================================

import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  InternalServerErrorException,
  Logger,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository, DataSource, In } from 'typeorm';
import { Blog } from './entities/blog.entity';
import { BlogTranslation } from './entities/blog-translation.entity';
import { BlogImage } from './entities/blog-image.entity';
import { Author } from './entities/author.entity';
import { Tag } from './entities/tag.entity';
import { CreateBlogDto } from './dto/create-blog.dto';
import { UpdateBlogDto } from './dto/update-blog.dto';
import { DEFAULT_LANGUAGE } from '../../common/constants';
import { BlogStatus } from './entities/blog-status.enum';
import slugify from 'slugify';

@Injectable()
export class BlogService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(BlogService.name);

  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Blog)
    private blogRepo: Repository<Blog>,
    @InjectRepository(BlogTranslation)
    private translationRepo: Repository<BlogTranslation>,
    @InjectRepository(BlogImage)
    private imageRepo: Repository<BlogImage>,
    @InjectRepository(Author)
    private authorRepo: Repository<Author>,
    @InjectRepository(Tag)
    private tagRepo: Repository<Tag>,
    private dataSource: DataSource,
  ) {}

  private async getBlogEntity(id: string, withUnpublished = false): Promise<Blog> {
    const where: any = { id };
    if (!withUnpublished) {
      where.status = BlogStatus.PUBLISHED;
    }
    const blog = await this.blogRepo.findOne({
      where,
      relations: ['translations', 'author', 'tags', 'comments', 'images'],
    });
    if (!blog) throw new NotFoundException('Blog not found');
    return blog;
  }

  private getTranslatedBlog(blog: Blog, language: string) {
    const translation = blog.translations?.find((t) => t.language === language);
    if (!translation) {
      const fallback = blog.translations?.[0];
      if (!fallback) throw new NotFoundException('No translation found');
      return {
        id: blog.id,
        slug: blog.slug,
        status: blog.status,
        publishedAt: blog.publishedAt,
        author: blog.author,
        tags: blog.tags,
        comments: blog.comments,
        images: blog.images,
        createdAt: blog.createdAt,
        updatedAt: blog.updatedAt,
        title: fallback.title,
        subtitle: fallback.subtitle,
        excerpt: fallback.excerpt,
        content: fallback.content,
      };
    }
    return {
      id: blog.id,
      slug: blog.slug,
      status: blog.status,
      publishedAt: blog.publishedAt,
      author: blog.author,
      tags: blog.tags,
      comments: blog.comments,
      images: blog.images,
      createdAt: blog.createdAt,
      updatedAt: blog.updatedAt,
      title: translation.title,
      subtitle: translation.subtitle,
      excerpt: translation.excerpt,
      content: translation.content,
    };
  }

  private generateSlug(title: string): string {
    return slugify(title, { lower: true, strict: true, locale: 'en' }) + '-' + Date.now().toString(36);
  }

  async create(createDto: CreateBlogDto) {
    const queryRunner = this.dataSource.createQueryRunner();
    await queryRunner.connect();
    await queryRunner.startTransaction();

    try {
      const primaryTranslation = createDto.translations[0];
      const slug = this.generateSlug(primaryTranslation.title);

      const blog = queryRunner.manager.create(Blog, {
        slug,
        status: createDto.status ?? BlogStatus.DRAFT,
        publishedAt: createDto.publishedAt,
      });
      await queryRunner.manager.save(blog);

      // ترجمه‌ها
      if (createDto.translations?.length) {
        const translations = createDto.translations.map((t) =>
          queryRunner.manager.create(BlogTranslation, { ...t, blog }),
        );
        await queryRunner.manager.save(translations);
      }

      // نویسنده
      if (createDto.authorId) {
        const author = await this.authorRepo.findOne({ where: { id: createDto.authorId } });
        if (!author) throw new NotFoundException('Author not found');
        blog.author = author;
      } else {
        blog.author = null; // اختیاری، پیش‌فرض null است
      }
      await queryRunner.manager.save(blog);

      // برچسب‌ها
      if (createDto.tagIds?.length) {
        const tags = await this.tagRepo.findBy({ id: In(createDto.tagIds) });
        if (tags.length !== createDto.tagIds.length) {
          throw new NotFoundException('Some tag IDs are invalid');
        }
        blog.tags = tags;
        await queryRunner.manager.save(blog);
      }

      // تصاویر
      if (createDto.images?.length) {
        const images = createDto.images.map((img) =>
          queryRunner.manager.create(BlogImage, { ...img, blog }),
        );
        await queryRunner.manager.save(images);
      }

      await queryRunner.commitTransaction();
      return this.findOne(blog.id, DEFAULT_LANGUAGE, true);
    } catch (error) {
      await queryRunner.rollbackTransaction();
      this.logger.error('Error creating blog', error.stack);
      throw new InternalServerErrorException(error.message);
    } finally {
      await queryRunner.release();
    }
  }

  async findAll(language: string = DEFAULT_LANGUAGE, includeAll = false) {
    const whereCondition = includeAll ? {} : { status: BlogStatus.PUBLISHED };
    const blogs = await this.blogRepo.find({
      where: whereCondition,
      relations: ['translations', 'author', 'tags', 'comments', 'images'],
      order: { createdAt: 'DESC' },
    });
    return blogs.map((b) => this.getTranslatedBlog(b, language));
  }

  async findOne(
    id: string,
    language: string = DEFAULT_LANGUAGE,
    allowUnpublished = false) {
    const blog = await this.getBlogEntity(id, allowUnpublished);
    return this.getTranslatedBlog(blog, language);
  }

  async update(id: string, updateDto: UpdateBlogDto) {
    const queryRunner = this.dataSource.createQueryRunner();
    await queryRunner.connect();
    await queryRunner.startTransaction();

    try {
      const blog = await queryRunner.manager.findOne(Blog, {
        where: { id },
        relations: ['translations', 'tags', 'author', 'images'],
      });
      if (!blog) throw new NotFoundException('Blog not found');

      // فیلدهای ساده
      if (updateDto.status !== undefined) blog.status = updateDto.status;
      if (updateDto.publishedAt !== undefined) blog.publishedAt = updateDto.publishedAt;

      // به‌روزرسانی slug در صورت تغییر عنوان اولین ترجمه
      if (updateDto.translations?.length) {
        const firstTrans = updateDto.translations[0];
        if (firstTrans.title) {
          blog.slug = this.generateSlug(firstTrans.title);
        }
      }
      await queryRunner.manager.save(blog);

      // ترجمه‌ها
      if (updateDto.translations && updateDto.translations.length > 0) {
        await queryRunner.manager.delete(BlogTranslation, { blog: { id } });
        const newTranslations = updateDto.translations.map((t) =>
          queryRunner.manager.create(BlogTranslation, { ...t, blog }),
        );
        await queryRunner.manager.save(newTranslations);
      }

      // نویسنده
      if ('authorId' in updateDto) {
        if (updateDto.authorId === null) {
          blog.author = null;
        } else {
          const author = await this.authorRepo.findOne({ where: { id: updateDto.authorId } });
          if (!author) throw new NotFoundException('Author not found');
          blog.author = author;
        }
        await queryRunner.manager.save(blog);
      }

      if ('tagIds' in updateDto) {
        if (updateDto.tagIds === null || (Array.isArray(updateDto.tagIds) && updateDto.tagIds.length === 0)) {
          // حذف تمام برچسب‌ها
          blog.tags = [];
        } else if (Array.isArray(updateDto.tagIds)) {
          const tags = await this.tagRepo.findBy({ id: In(updateDto.tagIds) });
          if (tags.length !== updateDto.tagIds.length) {
            throw new NotFoundException('Some tag IDs are invalid');
          }
          blog.tags = tags;
        }
        await queryRunner.manager.save(blog);
      }

      // تصاویر (جایگزینی کامل)
      if (updateDto.images) {
        await queryRunner.manager.delete(BlogImage, { blog: { id } });
        const newImages = updateDto.images.map((img) =>
          queryRunner.manager.create(BlogImage, { ...img, blog }),
        );
        await queryRunner.manager.save(newImages);
      }

      await queryRunner.commitTransaction();
      return this.findOne(id, DEFAULT_LANGUAGE, true);
    } catch (error) {
      await queryRunner.rollbackTransaction();
      this.logger.error(`Error updating blog ${id}`, error.stack);
      throw new InternalServerErrorException(error.message);
    } finally {
      await queryRunner.release();
    }
  }

  async remove(id: string) {
    const blog = await this.getBlogEntity(id, true);
    await this.blogRepo.remove(blog);
    return { message: 'Blog deleted successfully' };
  }
}

import {
  IsArray,
  ValidateNested,
  IsOptional,
  IsUUID,
  IsEnum,
  ArrayMinSize,
  ValidateIf,
} from 'class-validator';
import { Type } from 'class-transformer';
import { CreateBlogTranslationDto } from './create-blog-translation.dto';
import { BlogStatus } from '../entities/blog-status.enum';
import { CreateBlogImageDto } from './create-blog-image.dto';
import { ApiProperty, ApiPropertyOptional } from '@nestjs/swagger';

export class CreateBlogDto {
  @IsArray()
  @ValidateNested({ each: true })
  @Type(() => CreateBlogTranslationDto)
  @ArrayMinSize(1)
  @ApiProperty({
    type: [CreateBlogTranslationDto],
    description: 'لیست ترجمه‌های بلاگ (حداقل یک آیتم)',
    example: [
      {
        language: 'fa',
        title: 'عنوان فارسی',
        content: 'مطلب به فارسی',
        subtitle: 'زیرنویس',
        excerpt: 'خلاصه',
      },
    ],
  })
  @ArrayMinSize(1)
  translations: CreateBlogTranslationDto[];

  @IsOptional()
  @IsEnum(BlogStatus)
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ enum: BlogStatus, default: BlogStatus.DRAFT })
  status?: BlogStatus;

  @ApiPropertyOptional({ type: [CreateBlogImageDto] })
  @IsOptional()
  @IsArray()
  @ValidateNested({ each: true })
  @Type(() => CreateBlogImageDto)
  images?: CreateBlogImageDto[];

  @ValidateIf((o) => o.authorId !== undefined && o.authorId !== null)
  @IsUUID()
  @ApiPropertyOptional({
    type: String,
    format: 'uuid',
    description: 'شناسه نویسنده',
  })
  authorId?: string | null;

  @ValidateIf((o) => o.tagIds !== null && o.tagIds !== undefined)
  @IsArray()
  @IsUUID('4', { each: true })
  @ApiPropertyOptional({
    type: [String],
    format: 'uuid',
    description: 'آرایه شناسه تگ‌ها',
  })
  tagIds?: string[] | null;

  @IsOptional()
  @ApiPropertyOptional({ type: Date, description: 'تاریخ انتشار' })
  publishedAt?: Date;
}

import {
  Entity,
  PrimaryGeneratedColumn,
  Column,
  ManyToOne,
  ManyToMany,
  JoinTable,
  OneToMany,
  CreateDateColumn,
  UpdateDateColumn,
} from "typeorm";
import { Author } from "./author.entity";
import { Tag } from "./tag.entity";
import { Comment } from "./comment.entity";
import { BlogTranslation } from "./blog-translation.entity";
import { BlogStatus } from "./blog-status.enum";
import { BlogImage } from "./blog-image.entity";

@Entity("blogs")
export class Blog {
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn("uuid")
  id: string;

  @Column({ unique: true })
  slug: string; // برای سئو و آدرس‌دهی – از عنوان تولید می‌شود

  @Column({
    type: "enum",
    enum: BlogStatus,
    default: BlogStatus.DRAFT,
  })
  status: BlogStatus;

  @Column({ type: "timestamp", nullable: true, default: null })
  publishedAt: Date;

  @ManyToOne(() => Author, (author) => author.blogs, { nullable: true })
  author: Author | null;

  @OneToMany(() => BlogImage, (image) => image.blog, { cascade: true })
  images: BlogImage[];

  @ManyToMany(() => Tag, (tag) => tag.blogs)
  @JoinTable({ name: "blog_tags" })
  tags: Tag[];

  @OneToMany(() => Comment, (comment) => comment.blog, { cascade: true })
  comments: Comment[];

  @OneToMany(() => BlogTranslation, (trans) => trans.blog, { cascade: true })
  translations: BlogTranslation[];

  @CreateDateColumn()
  createdAt: Date;

  @UpdateDateColumn()
  updatedAt: Date;
}

// src/modules/contact/contact.controller.ts
import {
  Controller,
  Get,
  Post,
  Body,
  Patch,
  Delete,
  Param,
  UseGuards,
  Req,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { AuthGuard } from '@nestjs/passport';
import {
  ApiTags,
  ApiBearerAuth,
  ApiOperation,
  ApiOkResponse,
  ApiCreatedResponse,
  ApiUnauthorizedResponse,
  ApiParam,
  ApiBody,
} from '@nestjs/swagger';
import { ContactService } from './contact.service';
import { UpdateContactDto } from './dto/update-contact.dto';
import { CreateMessageDto } from './dto/create-message.dto';
import { Contact } from './entities/contact.entity';
import { EmailMessage } from './entities/email-message.entity';
import { MessageResponseDto } from '../../common/dto/message-response.dto';
import type { Request } from 'express';

@ApiTags('contact')
@Controller('contact')
export class ContactController {
  constructor(private readonly contactService: ContactService) {}

  @Get()
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'دریافت اطلاعات تماس (عمومی)' })
  @ApiOkResponse({ type: Contact })
  getContactInfo() {
    return this.contactService.getContactInfo();
  }

  @Patch()
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'به‌روزرسانی اطلاعات تماس (ادمین)' })
  @ApiBody({ type: UpdateContactDto })
  @ApiOkResponse({ type: Contact })
  @ApiUnauthorizedResponse({ description: 'نیاز به ورود' })
  updateContactInfo(@Body() updateContactDto: UpdateContactDto) {
    return this.contactService.updateContactInfo(updateContactDto);
  }

  @Post('message')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'ارسال پیام جدید از فرم تماس (عمومی)' })
  @ApiBody({ type: CreateMessageDto })
  @ApiCreatedResponse({ type: MessageResponseDto })
  async sendMessage(@Body() dto: CreateMessageDto, @Req() req: Request) {
    const acceptLanguage = req.headers['accept-language'];
    const lang = acceptLanguage?.split(',')[0] || 'en';
    return this.contactService.submitMessage(dto, lang);
  }

  @Get('admin/messages')
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'دریافت همه پیام‌های دریافتی (ادمین)' })
  @ApiOkResponse({ type: [EmailMessage] })
  getAllMessages() {
    return this.contactService.findAllMessages();
  }

  @Get('admin/messages/:id')
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'دریافت جزئیات یک پیام (ادمین)' })
  @ApiParam({ name: 'id', type: String })
  @ApiOkResponse({ type: EmailMessage })
  getMessage(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.contactService.findOneMessage(id);
  }

  @Delete('admin/messages/:id')
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
  @ApiOperation({ summary: 'حذف پیام (ادمین)' })
  @ApiParam({ name: 'id', type: String })
  @ApiOkResponse({ description: 'پیام با موفقیت حذف شد' })
  deleteMessage(@Param('id') id: string) {
    return this.contactService.removeMessage(id);
  }
}

// src/modules/contact/contact.service.ts
import {
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
  Logger,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { InjectRepository } from '@nestjs/typeorm';
import { Repository } from 'typeorm';
import { Contact } from './entities/contact.entity';
import { EmailMessage } from './entities/email-message.entity';
import { UpdateContactDto } from './dto/update-contact.dto';
import { CreateMessageDto } from './dto/create-message.dto';
import { MailerService } from '@nestjs-modules/mailer';
import { I18nService } from 'nestjs-i18n';

@Injectable()
export class ContactService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(ContactService.name);

  constructor(
    @InjectRepository(Contact)
    private contactRepo: Repository<Contact>,
    @InjectRepository(EmailMessage)
    private messageRepo: Repository<EmailMessage>,
    private mailerService: MailerService,
    private i18n: I18nService,
  ) {}

  // ---- اطلاعات تماس (فقط یک رکورد با id ثابت) ----
  private async getContactEntity(): Promise<Contact> {
    const FIXED_ID = '1'; // چون فیلد id از نوع uuid است، مقدار ثابت '1'
    let contact = await this.contactRepo.findOne({ where: { id: FIXED_ID } });
    if (!contact) {
      // ایجاد رکورد پیش‌فرض
      contact = this.contactRepo.create({
        id: FIXED_ID,
        email: 'admin@example.com',
      });
      await this.contactRepo.save(contact);
      this.logger.log('Default contact record created with id=1');
    }
    return contact;
  }

  async getContactInfo(): Promise<Contact> {
    return this.getContactEntity();
  }

  async updateContactInfo(updateDto: UpdateContactDto): Promise<Contact> {
    const contact = await this.getContactEntity();
    Object.assign(contact, updateDto);
    await this.contactRepo.save(contact);
    return contact;
  }

  // ---- مدیریت پیام‌های فرم تماس ----
  async submitMessage(dto: CreateMessageDto, lang: string = 'en') {
    // 1. ذخیره در دیتابیس
    const contact = await this.getContactEntity();
    const newMessage = this.messageRepo.create({
      senderName: dto.senderName,
      senderEmail: dto.senderEmail,
      subject: dto.subject,
      body: dto.message,
      contact,
      contactId: contact.id,
    });
    await this.messageRepo.save(newMessage);

    // 2. ارسال ایمیل به ادمین (اگر تنظیمات SMTP موجود باشد)
    const adminEmail = process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL;
    // بخش ارسال ایمیل در contact.service.ts
    if (adminEmail) {
      try {
        const htmlContent = `
      <div style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;">
        <h2>📬 پیام جدید از سایت</h2>
        <p><strong>نام:</strong> ${dto.senderName}</p>
        <p><strong>ایمیل:</strong> ${dto.senderEmail}</p>
        <p><strong>موضوع:</strong> ${dto.subject}</p>
        <p><strong>متن پیام:</strong></p>
        <div style="background: #f9f9f9; padding: 15px; border-radius: 5px;">
          ${dto.message.replace(/\n/g, '<br>')}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
        await this.mailerService.sendMail({
          to: adminEmail,
          subject: `📬 پیام جدید از ${dto.senderName}: ${dto.subject}`,
          html: htmlContent,
        });
        this.logger.log(`Email sent to admin for message ID ${newMessage.id}`);
      } catch (err) {
        this.logger.error(`Failed to send email: ${err.message}`, err.stack);
      }
    }

    // 3. پیام موفقیت ترجمه‌شده
    const successMessage = this.i18n.translate('contact.message_sent', { lang });
    return { message: successMessage };
  }

  // ---- مدیریت ادمین ----
  async findAllMessages(): Promise<EmailMessage[]> {
    return this.messageRepo.find({
      order: { receivedAt: 'DESC' },
    });
  }

  async findOneMessage(id: string): Promise<EmailMessage> {
    const msg = await this.messageRepo.findOne({ where: { id } });
    if (!msg) throw new NotFoundException('Message not found');
    return msg;
  }

  async removeMessage(id: string): Promise<void> {
    const msg = await this.findOneMessage(id);
    await this.messageRepo.remove(msg);
  }
}

import {
  Entity,

  UpdateDateColumn,
} from 'typeorm';

@Entity('contacts')
export class Contact {
  @ApiProperty({ example: '1', description: 'شناسه ثابت (همیشه 1)' })
  @PrimaryGeneratedColumn('uuid')
  id: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'admin@example.com' })
  @Column({ unique: true })
  email: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: '09123456789', nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  mobilePhone: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: '021-12345678', nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  landlinePhone: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'تهران، خیابان آزادی، پلاک ۱۲', nullable: true })
  @Column({ type: 'text', nullable: true })
  address: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'https://instagram.com/username', nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  instagramUrl: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'https://t.me/username', nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  telegramUrl: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'https://github.com/username', nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  githubUrl: string;

  @ApiProperty({ example: 'https://linkedin.com/in/username', nullable: true })
  @Column({ nullable: true })
  linkedinUrl: string;

  @ApiProperty({ type: () => [Message], readOnly: true })
  @OneToMany(() => Message, (message) => message.contact, { cascade: true })
  messages: Message[];

  @ApiProperty({ type: () => [EmailMessage], readOnly: true })
  @OneToMany(() => EmailMessage, (email) => email.contact, { cascade: true })
  receivedEmails: EmailMessage[];

  @ApiProperty()
  @CreateDateColumn()
  createdAt: Date;

  @ApiProperty()
  @UpdateDateColumn()
  updatedAt: Date;
}

import { HeroService } from './hero.service';
import { UpsertHeroDto } from './dto/upsert-hero.dto';
import { DEFAULT_LANGUAGE } from '../../../common/constants';

@ApiTags('site-hero')
@Controller('site/hero')
export class HeroController {
  constructor(private readonly heroService: HeroService) {}

  @Get()
  get(@Query('lang') lang?: string) {
    return this.heroService.getByLanguage(lang || DEFAULT_LANGUAGE);
  }

  @Get('admin')
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')
  getAll() {
    return this.heroService.getAll();
  }

  @Put()
  @UseGuards(AuthGuard('jwt'))
  @ApiBearerAuth('access-token')

    return this.heroService.upsert(dto);
  }
}
